description: Source code for handling Web Configuration Aker interactions, including sending and receiving messages, parsing payloads, managing global status, and processing Aker update/delete requests.

methods.name: get_global_client_con
methods.description: Returns pointer to global client condition variable.

methods.name: get_global_client_mut
methods.description: Returns pointer to global client mutex.

methods.name: get_send_aker_flag
methods.description: Returns the current value of send_aker_flag.

methods.name: akerwait__
methods.description: Waits for specified seconds or until shutdown signal.

methods.name: send_aker_blob
methods.description: Sends Aker blob message to parodus.

methods.name: checkAkerStatus
methods.description: Sends a retrieve request to check Aker registration status.

methods.name: updateAkerMaxRetry
methods.description: Updates retry count and status for Aker document.

methods.name: processAkerSubdoc
methods.description: Processes Aker sub-document, decodes payload, validates, and sends blob if valid.

methods.name: processAkerUpdateDelete
methods.description: Processes incoming WRP messages for Aker update or delete requests.
